caption:
Tokyo to Kawaguchiko: the bus costs less than half 🗻
With a big suitcase, start at Busta Shinjuku.

🥇 Highway bus · one case each

🎫 ¥2,000 booked online.

🧳 One big case each rides free in the hold.

⏱️ About 1 h 45, depending on traffic.

🥈 Fuji Excursion · fixed arrival time

🚆 Direct from Shinjuku, no road traffic.

🎫 ¥4,200, and weekend seats often sell out.

💡 Seats gone? Fujikyu also sells
an unreserved-seat ticket for it.
